verdict.rationale: Airwallex documents a Hosted Payment Page that is "secure, pre-built" and "hosted by Airwallex", plus a Drop-in Element that collects payment fields. That implies card entry happens on Airwallex-controlled surfaces rather than the merchant's servers, but the evidence never explicitly mentions tokenization, PCI DSS scope reduction, or SAQ eligibility. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that card data is tokenized and never touches merchant servers, PCI DSS scope/SAQ guidance, Airwallex's own PCI certification, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can keep my systems out of most of PCI DSS scope because card data is tokenized and never touches my servers

citations.quote: Hosted Payment Page is a secure, pre-built payment page hosted by Airwallex that lets you accept multiple payment methods with a single integration.
Automatically adjusts input fields to collect information based on the payment method and country.
